headline.purpose: Major evidence sections and brief-page conclusions.

label.purpose: Compact decisions, controls, statuses, and thresholds.

shadows.name: logo-plaque
shadows.purpose: Separates the verified circular mark from dark fields without a colored glow.

shadows.name: decision-surface
shadows.purpose: Provides compact depth beneath the decision boundary.

shadows.name: evidence-anchor

shadows.name: tooltip
shadows.purpose: Keeps chart evidence readable above dense plotted marks.

shadows.name: evidence-ribbon

shadows.name: rail-node

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Soft Orbit Blue action for downloading or opening the primary evidence artifact.
components.css: .ds-primary-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 42px; padding: 9px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; color: var(--navy, #071632); background: var(--blue-soft, #84baff); font: 700 0.82rem/1.25 var(--font-display, 'Space Grotesk', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 170ms ease-out; } .ds-primary-action:hover { color: #020b19; background: #b9d8ff; } .ds-primary-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--gold, #f2b63d); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Secondary Action
components.description: Outlined navy action for moving between dashboard and executive brief.
components.css: .ds-secondary-action { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 42px; padding: 9px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #37608f); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--muted-bright, #cad7e7); background: rgba(7, 22, 50, 0.72); font: 700 0.82rem/1.25 var(--font-display, 'Space Grotesk', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); text-decoration: none; transition: border-color 170ms ease-out, color 170ms ease-out; } .ds-secondary-action:hover { color: var(--text, #f7faff); border-color: var(--blue-soft, #84baff); } .ds-secondary-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--gold, #f2b63d); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Decision Badge
components.description: Compact non-interactive label for retain, warning, or gate state.
components.css: .ds-decision-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 30px; padding: 5px 11px; border: 1px solid rgba(242, 182, 61, 0.68); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--gold-soft, #ffdc91); background: rgba(242, 182, 61, 0.09); font: 760 0.75rem/1.25 var(--font-display, 'Space Grotesk', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); letter-spacing: 0.075em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Evidence Surface
components.description: Primary analytical container with anchored depth and a strong evidence boundary.
components.html:
12-week held-out evaluation

Actual contacts created compared with Chronos p50, its p10-p90 band, and persistence.
components.css: .ds-evidence-surface { padding: 22px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #28456d); border-radius: var(--radius, 14px); color: var(--text, #f7faff); background: rgba(7, 22, 50, 0.82); box-shadow: 0 10px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.32); } .ds-evidence-surface h3 { margin: 0 0 9px; font: 700 1.28rem/1.18 var(--font-display, 'Space Grotesk', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); letter-spacing: -0.018em; } .ds-evidence-surface p { max-width: 72ch; margin: 0; color: var(--muted, #aebed3); font: 400 0.77rem/1.55 var(--font-body, 'DM Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); }

components.name: Paper Readout
components.description: Rare light reading surface for executive interpretation and verified boundaries.
components.css: .ds-paper-readout { padding: 18px 20px; border-radius: var(--radius-small, 12px); color: var(--ink, #09152b); background: var(--paper, #f4f7fb); } .ds-paper-readout span, .ds-paper-readout strong, .ds-paper-readout small { display: block; } .ds-paper-readout span, .ds-paper-readout small { color: #52647d; font: 700 0.75rem/1.35 var(--font-body, 'DM Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); } .ds-paper-readout strong { margin-top: 5px; font: 700 2rem/1 var(--font-display, 'Space Grotesk', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-paper-readout small { margin-top: 8px; }

components.name: Evidence Ribbon

components.html:

components.css: .ds-evidence-ribbon { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong, #37608f); border-radius: var(--radius, 14px); color: var(--text, #f7faff); background: linear-gradient(115deg, var(--ribbon-orbit, #10366e), #0a2551 68%, var(--ribbon-deep, #091d40)); box-shadow: 0 9px 14px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.27); } .ds-evidence-ribbon > div { min-height: 126px; padding: 20px 22px; border-right: 1px solid rgba(202, 215, 231, 0.15); } .ds-evidence-ribbon > div:last-child { border-right: 0; } .ds-evidence-ribbon span, .ds-evidence-ribbon strong, .ds-evidence-ribbon small { display: block; } .ds-evidence-ribbon span { color: #c7dbf5; font: 700 0.75rem/1.35 var(--font-body, 'DM Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); } .ds-evidence-ribbon strong { margin-top: 8px; font: 700 2rem/1 var(--font-display, 'Space Grotesk', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); letter-spacing: -0.025em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-evidence-ribbon small { margin-top: 9px; color: var(--ribbon-caption, #b9cce5); font: 400 0.75rem/1.35 var(--font-body, 'DM Sans', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-evidence-ribbon { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .ds-evidence-ribbon > div { min-height: 110px; border-right: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(202, 215, 231, 0.15); } .ds-evidence-ribbon > div:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } }

components.name: Evidence Tab Navigation
components.description: Keyboard-ready evidence navigation that becomes a 2 by 2 grid on mobile.
components.html: <nav class="ds-tab-list" aria-label="Forecast pilot evidence views"><button aria-selected="true">Evaluation</button><button aria-selected="false">Data quality</button><button aria-selected="false">Integration</button><button aria-selected="false">Next test</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-tab-list { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #28456d); background: transparent; } .ds-tab-list button { position: relative; min-height: 46px; padding: 10px 17px; border: 0; color: var(--muted, #aebed3); background: transparent; font: 700 0.84rem/1.25 var(--font-display, 'Space Grotesk', 'Segoe UI', sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab-list button::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 17px; bottom: -1px; left: 17px; height: 2px; background: transparent; transform: scaleX(0.35); transition: transform 170ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 170ms ease-out; } .ds-tab-list button:hover, .ds-tab-list button[aria-selected='true'] { color: var(--text, #f7faff); } .ds-tab-list button[aria-selected='true']::after { background: var(--blue, #2f82ff); transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-tab-list button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--gold, #f2b63d); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (max-width: 700px) { .ds-tab-list { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 1px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #28456d); background: var(--rule, #28456d); } .ds-tab-list button { width: 100%; min-width: 0; padding-right: 10px; padding-left: 10px; background: var(--night, #041027); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-tab-list button::after { transition-duration: 0.01ms; } }

narrative.overview:
This is a restrained executive evidence system, not a forecast spectacle. Near-black Momentum navy fields make verified figures, uncertainty, and decision boundaries feel deliberate; bright color is reserved for meaning rather than decoration. The shipped world extends the circular Momentum 360 mark with crisp rules, compact evidence controls, exact tabular figures, and candid status language.

The system is dense enough for comparison but never visually frantic. It alternates dark analytical fields with rare paper surfaces that translate technical evidence into an executive read. Charts, rails, tables, and print pages share the same palette and type grammar so the web dashboard and portable brief remain one evidence package without inheriting each other's page composition.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black navy canvases with tonal blue layering rather than generic card grids.
Orbit Blue for interaction, chart continuity, and governed paths.
Signal Gold for decisions, warnings, abstention, and baseline outcomes.
Self-hosted Space Grotesk display type paired with self-hosted DM Sans body type.
Restrained rounded geometry, exact rules, tabular numerals, and paper reading relief.
Complete keyboard, visible-focus, reduced-motion, responsive, and print behavior.

rules.name: The Two-Signal Rule
rules.body: Orbit Blue means analytical continuity or interaction; Signal Gold means a decision, warning, baseline, or threshold. Do not swap their roles for variety.

rules.name: The Paper Relief Rule
rules.body: Cool Paper is reserved for executive interpretation, coverage readouts, and boundary summaries. It is relief from the navy field, not an alternate page theme.

rules.name: The Verdict-Then-Method Rule
rules.body: Space Grotesk leads with the decision and the numbers; DM Sans explains what the evidence does and does not establish.

rules.name: The Exact-Figure Rule
rules.body: Quantitative evidence uses tabular lining figures. Labels may compress, but values must remain easy to compare across a rail, table, or gate.

rules.name: The Continuous Evidence Rule
rules.body: Related facts share one ruled structure so the reader can compare them as a set.

rules.name: The Reflow, Then Inspect Rule
rules.body: Collapse the page hierarchy before 900px; keep dense chart evidence inspectable inside an announced scroll region rather than shrinking it into illegibility.

rules.name: The Anchored-Depth Rule
rules.body: Use shadow only when a surface must sit above the evidence field or remain spatially anchored. Ordinary sections and tables use rules and tonal layering.

dos: Do lead with the decision state, then let charts, tables, and rails expose the proof behind it.
Do keep Orbit Blue and Signal Gold semantically separate under the Two-Signal Rule.
Do use Cool Paper sparingly for plain-language interpretation and verified boundaries.
Do preserve whole-number evidence, tabular figures, complete labels, and visible caveats.
Do maintain the 3px Signal Gold focus outline, keyboard tab behavior, announced chart scrolling, and complete reduced-motion state.
Do preserve the exact Letter print canvas, vector evidence, forced colors, and shadow-free output.
donts: Don't turn every metric or paragraph into a separate rounded card; use continuous ruled structures for related evidence.
Don't use Signal Gold as a generic decorative accent or Orbit Blue as a decision-warning substitute.
Don't fill large page regions with Cool Paper or invert the system into a light dashboard.
Don't use pill geometry for ordinary containers, headings, or decorative labels.
Don't introduce motion beyond short state feedback, and never require motion to reveal evidence.
Don't make surface-specific first-viewport or four-page composition a global template; those decisions remain in the surface briefs.
